decision: Join keyed on trace cwd + time-window overlap + thread_id session grouping; analysis-time only
alternatives: stamp runId into trace metadata via plugin
reasoning: traces carry no runId (CC_LANGSMITH_METADATA static per session); spec mandates zero plugin coupling; cwd+time+thread_id is the only key available in both records
risk: clock skew or concurrent runs in same repo could misattribute a root run to the wrong runId/step

decision: Join lives in Stage A as new A5 deterministic script subsection; no new stage
reasoning: spec names it a Stage A extension; A3 already script-computes aggregates with zero LLM reads, A5 mirrors that pattern; downstream stages consume outputs like other A aggregates
risk: A5 outputs unused by B/C/D would be dead fields — mitigated by naming consumers inline (P1 review must-fix learning)

decision: No new CLI flag; join runs automatically and degrades gracefully per repo
reasoning: spec lists no flag; graceful skip covers the missing-checkout case; flag surface growth needs user demand first
risk: user cannot disable a slow join over many repos; revisit if runtime complaints surface

decision: Cost allocation: full root-run total_cost to the single step interval containing start_time; uncontained runs go to unjoined tail
reasoning: root runs are single turns and rarely span step boundaries; single-interval rule is deterministic and explainable in the report
risk: long turns spanning a step transition slightly overstate the starting step's cost

decision: Ledger mode-transition consecutive-timestamp deltas are the primary pipelineStep interval source; telemetry mode.start/mode.end preferred only when it yields >=1 interval per repo (currently never)
alternatives: telemetry-primary with ledger fallback on absent files (iteration-1 design
silently no-ops); resurrect a mode.start/mode.end emitter (out of scope)
reasoning: Verified against real data: 0 mode.start/mode.end records across all .luca/telemetry/*.jsonl, 353 mode-transition rows in .luca/ledger.jsonl; fallback trigger 'telemetry absent' would never fire since files exist but yield zero intervals
risk: ledger deltas approximate step duration (interval open until next transition); degraded tuple has nullable runId/wave and slug depends on nearest slug-bearing telemetry record

decision: Applied the gate-research proportional cost-allocation rule (wall-clock overlap fraction across all overlapped step intervals; out-of-interval window portions to the unjoined tail) in Stage A5, superseding the plan's single-interval start_time containment rule
alternatives: proportional overlap allocation per gate resolution
reasoning: Confidence-gate resolution explicitly supersedes the plan; no plan ac probe pinned the containment rule so no probe conflict; containment degenerate case preserved
risk: If a downstream reviewer diffs against plan.md line 31 verbatim they will see a deviation; the resolution is documented in plan-review.md
reviewHint: Cost-allocation paragraph in A5 intentionally deviates from plan.md's single-interval rule per gate-research resolution

decision: Placed the '### Pipeline Attribution' report section between Behavior Smells and Top Findings in Stage D
reasoning: Plan fixed the section name and contents but not its position; attribution tables are aggregate evidence like Smells and feed Top Findings context, so they sit directly upstream of findings
risk: Reviewer may prefer attribution adjacent to Spend & Trends; purely presentational, no probe depends on position

decision: Folded 'unreadable ledger/telemetry files' into the luca-dir-missing enum value rather than adding a sixth reason
reasoning: fix_context mandated the exact 5-value enum (checkout-not-local, luca-dir-missing, no-interval-overlap, joined-partial-window, pending-no-end-time); unreadable files are semantically closest to luca-dir-missing, so the enum value's parenthetical definition names them explicitly
risk: Reports conflate a permissions failure with an absent .luca/ directory; acceptable since both mean the same skip action
reviewHint: Check the Graceful skip enum parenthetical covers unreadable files under luca-dir-missing
